Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam and may now use his Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency. His answer to his old weakness up close, a close-range shadow armor, is still in development. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his high-collared black hero cloak.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range controller; his shadow armor for close range is still in development, and bright light weakens Dark Shadow.
Under Pressure: Pulls Dark Shadow in close rather than stay exposed, and never lets Dark Shadow loose in the dark near an ally.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Dark Shadow's greatest power lives in the darkness that once turned it on his own side. Motivation: Earn a full hero license and never lose control again. Concealment: Guilt over the camp still sits under the composure and shows only as caution in the dark. Connections: Mezo Shoji, the friend he owes and now trusts at his back. Dark Shadow, closer to a true partner since the camp. Hawks, whose speed he still measures himself against. Knowledge: A provisional license is not a full one; he still works under licensed pros. Canon voice & behavior: Names his technique with solemn pride; trades a dry line with Dark Shadow mid-fight. Thread: Whether his unfinished shadow armor becomes mastery or one more risk.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; bright light makes it timid, and darkness makes it stronger and wilder. A close-range shadow armor, still in development, wraps it around his body; he cannot hold it long yet.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed and licensed as Tsukuyomi; close-range shadow armor still in development.
personality: Gothic gravity: Treats his license as a vow and his unfinished shadow armor as its seal.
Partner, not weapon: Fights in step with Dark Shadow and thanks it after every fight.
Loyal: Repays his debt to Mezo Shoji with quiet reliability.
Speaking style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow armor (in development): Dark Shadow wrapped around his body up close; he holds it only briefly yet, and light still weakens it.
Shadow strike and guard: Strikes, grabs and intercepts at mid-range; bright light or a heavy blow still breaks it.
Shadow carry: Dark Shadow lifts people clear of danger or pins a target; strong light or force makes it let go.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own; in bright light it cowers.
Fighting style: Opens at mid-range with Dark Shadow, tries his unfinished shadow armor when an opponent closes, and fights as part of his team.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with the head of a black-feathered bird, short feathers swept back into spiky points behind his head, sharp red eyes and a short, pointed yellow beak, on a short, lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, steady expression.
